commands.purpose: Read-only baseline of existing experiment-fixture apparatus.

iterationNotes.detail: The first run exposed a missing local test-module export. The test import was corrected before the recorded passing run; no hosted operation occurred.

fixtureClaims.name: HTML RPC boundary
fixtureClaims.reference: Copied serializable values, delayed handler completion, and explicit failure callback.
fixtureClaims.localObservation: Reference copied a request, converted [undefined] to [null], returned handler results in fast-before-slow order for 0 ms versus 12 ms work, and reported an intentional failure. The direct seed returned {value: immediate}; the unsafe mutant returned the same Date object.
fixtureClaims.claimLimit: Not an Apps Script or browser emulator.

fixtureClaims.name: State, locking, idempotency, and cache
fixtureClaims.reference: Mutex-protected durable state and durable operation receipt; cache is derivative.
fixtureClaims.localObservation: Reference finished at value 2 with two durable commits and one duplicate replay. The no-lock seed made two commits but finished at value 1; cache-only restart replayed=false and durable snapshot stayed value 0 with no receipts; the pure read failed with lock unavailable only in the blanket-lock mutant.
fixtureClaims.claimLimit: Does not validate LockService, PropertiesService, CacheService, host retries, or exactly-once external effects.

fixtureClaims.name: Compatible batching
fixtureClaims.localObservation: Reference preserved a 2x2 grid with 1 synthetic call. The per-cell seed used 4 calls and exceeded a 1-call synthetic budget. The notification mutant changed operator@example.test from retry needed to approved.
fixtureClaims.claimLimit: Synthetic call counts are not current Apps Script quota or timing measurements.

unvalidatedLiveRequirements: Actual HtmlService RPC serializer, global exposure, browser sandbox, handler behavior, and concurrency cap.
Deployment access and executeAs identity, manifest scopes, consent, missing-scope denial, and trusted-side authorization.
LockService timeout/fairness and scope behavior; PropertiesService persistence; CacheService eviction/null behavior; host retry behavior.
SpreadsheetApp batch performance, account-specific current quotas, partial failures, active deployment identity, and consumer-visible endpoint behavior.
